description: This file is a Makefile used in a Linux-based embedded device build system. It defines device configurations, build rules, and image generation procedures for various hardware devices, including TP-Link, Enterasys, Aerohive, Watchguard, and Sophos devices.

methods.name: Build/spi-loader-okli-compile
methods.description: Rule to compile the spi loader for OKLI devices. It copies the spi-loader binary, invokes make in a subdirectory, and copies the resulting uImage.

methods.name: Build/spi-loader-okli
methods.description: Rule to concatenate loader-$(1) with the target file and replace it atomically.

methods.name: Device/aerohive_br200-wp
methods.description: Device configuration for Aerohive BR200-WP, specifying vendor, model, block size, kernel images, and image creation steps.

methods.name: Device/enterasys_ws-ap3715i
methods.description: Device configuration for Enterasys WS-AP3715i, including vendor details, kernel images, and image build instructions.

methods.name: Device/tplink_tl-wdr4900-v1
methods.description: TP-Link device configuration (WDR4900-v1) with hardware identifiers, kernel build rules (including spi-loader-okli), and image generation steps.

methods.name: Device/watchguard_firebox-t10
methods.description: Configuration for Watchguard Firebox T10 device, including packages and kernel image compression.

methods.name: Device/sophos_red-15w-rev1
methods.description: Configuration for Sophos RED 15w Rev.1 device, including kernel image compression and image packaging.
